posts.title: Math in MarkPDF is now good
posts.description: Thanks to MicroTeX now MarkPDF can now render math correctly. How correctly? Quite nicely! You just need to wrap your inline math in $...$ and your display math in $$...$$ . You can try it out in the playground Still no TeX engine required.

posts.title: Lanterns: A Guide for the Lost
posts.description: This is not about whether Lanterns is a good or bad show. It's about how people complain about it in ways that simply mean they failed to see it or to understand what they saw. Spoiler warnings for EVERYTHING . People blame kerry way too much for this when she had every reason to think he’d make a shield like he did before, we’ll get the full story in season 2 of lanterns https://t.co/gdFts7WSjk —

posts.title: Interview with Rob Pike
posts.description: A while ago I had the enormous pleasure of interviewing Rob Pike for Nerdearla . I am not a professional interviewer, so don't expect a Q&A format, it's more of a "hey, I read this neat thing you wrote, what do you think about [some related thing]" and I think it came out fine .
